labels.label: lie being told (reader)
labels.notes: Top deception neuron in the study, paired with L25.N6715. Held out (examples/lie-detector.md): lie vs same-words mistake 0.98, told-to-lie false vs true reply 1.00, lies vs honest twins 0.82–0.94; mistake vs truth 0.54. Peaks on the full stop after the lie lands, and on "lie" in "I cannot lie to you": reads lying in play.
